items.information: This is the first-ever WCA-sanctioned cubing competition in La Union! FOR RETURNERS: Base registration fee is 350php, good for 3 events. Additional events registered shall entail 50php additional registration fee each. FOR FIRST TIMERS: Base registration fee is 300php, good for 2 events. Additional events registered shall entail 50php additional registration fee each. Please see [Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ElyuCubeClash2024#40544-payment-details) tab for details. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbVJvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--002b77a3109d2de394c78455872ae7cdd76b558f/423542013_1155194298800968_9015821809504823381_n.jpg)

items.information: This competition is on a **Thursday evening** and will only feature blindfolded events. As a result, this competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
